site_name: Plot S10 Of The International Quarter, Stratford City Zone 2 (Also Known As International Quarter London), 5 Westfield Ave, London, E20 1HZ
description: Application for Reserved Matters Approval for layout, scale, design, appearance, access and landscaping pursuant to Condition 4 of the Plot S10 Outline Planning Permission (ref: 20/00146/OUT) comprising the construction of a predominantly commercial/educational building (Use Class E(g)/F.1), flexible retail floorspace (Class E/Sui Generis (drinking establishment/hot food take away)) and flexible office/education floorspace (Class E(g)/F.1), with associated servicing, blue badge parking, cycle parking, public realm, access and associated works.Planning Permission was not EIA development and no Environmental Statement was required to be submitted.
